title: MacGuard Cloud common definitions (PLANNED, v1)
description: DESIGN ONLY. MacGuard Cloud does not exist. Shared definitions referenced by the other cloud-*.schema.json files. Compatibility rule: additive changes (new optional properties, new enum values only where the consumer is told to ignore unknown values) keep /1; removing or renaming a property, tightening a type, or making an optional property required is a breaking change and requires a new id ending in /2.

schema_version.description: Major version of the contract; equals the trailing /N of the $id.

tenant_id.description: Opaque tenant identifier. Every record carries it; a record without it is rejected.

id.description: Opaque identifier with a type prefix (org_, hg_, usr_, host_, agt_, req_, res_, evd_, bsl_, att_, flt_). Random, not derived from personal data.

utc_datetime.description: RFC 3339 in UTC, always with the Z suffix.

status_badge.description: Every contract document is 'planned' until an implementation and its tests exist in this repository.

path_ref.description: A file path is never sent in clear unless the tenant policy says so. 'hashed' = HMAC-SHA-256 with a per-tenant key; 'encrypted' = AEAD ciphertext under a per-tenant key; 'clear' needs an explicit tenant policy value.

value.description: Hex HMAC, base64 ciphertext, or the path, according to mode.

key_id.description: Identifier of the per-tenant key used (never the key).

signature_envelope.description: Detached signature over the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical form of the document with this property removed. Agents sign with a per-agent key enrolled at opt-in; the service signs its own results with a service key.

signed_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical bytes that were signed.

trusted_timestamp.description: Independent proof of time. Primary: RFC 3161 TimeStampToken over the SHA-256 of the canonical document. Alternative: a Sigstore Rekor signed entry timestamp when the artefact is itself publicly logged.

tsa.description: TSA name or URL (rfc3161) or log URL (rekor-set).

token.description: base64 DER TimeStampToken (rfc3161) or base64 SET (rekor-set).

gen_time.description: Time asserted by the TSA, not by the agent.

idempotency_key.description: SHA-256 of the canonical document body (without signature and idempotency_key). Re-sending the same document is a no-op.
